最初做 PromptDirector，只是因为一个念头：我想做一条 AI 视频。: PromptDirector began with a simple thought: I wanted to make an AI video.
但真正动手时，才发现手头没有一套好用的创作资产。参考案例、视觉设定，还有能让模型: When I started, I realized I didn’t have a useful set of creative assets. References, visual development, and prompting methods that models could interpret consistently—all of it had to be built up, piece by piece.
于是我想，索性做一个采集插件吧。看到好的案例，就一键保存下来。没想到随着开发逐渐: So I thought: why not make a browser extension to collect them? Whenever I came across a good example, I could save it with one click. As development continued, more features grew out of that idea, eventually becoming the tool you see today.
这个插件里，有我认真投入的时间和心力。希望你会喜欢，也希望它能帮你把一个创作念头: I’ve put a lot of time and care into this extension. I hope you enjoy it, and that it helps you turn a creative idea into something real.
